title: Coherent Grothendieck group and dimension-support filtration
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A coherent object is an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] satisfying the finite-type and finite-type-kernel coherence condition [pqf-def-coherent]. Define $G_0(X)$ to be the free abelian group on coherent objects modulo the subgroup generated by $[M_2]-[M_1]-[M_3]$ for every short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$. Its canonical generator is the class $[M]$. For an integer $k$, define $F_kG_0(X)=0$ for $k<0$; otherwise it is the subgroup generated by $[M]$ for which the subspace of points with nonzero stalk has Krull dimension at most $k$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], agreeing on affine charts with ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For every commutative ring $B$, using the ordinary module tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], define $H_B=B\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G_0(X)$, canonically identified by tensor symmetry with $G_0(X)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}B$, and let $F_kH_B$ be the $B$-submodule generated by $b\otimes x$ with $x\in F_kG_0(X)$; equivalently it is the image of scalar extension of that subgroup.
